name: Blackwood Forest, Winding Trail
desc1: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush.
desc2: Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the
desc3: ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches
desc4: deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a
desc5: faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.
